title: Senior Packaging Product Design Engineer at Oura
summary: Senior Packaging Product Design Engineer at Oura
detailed: Enhance your health journey with Oura.
We are looking for a Senior Packaging Product Design Engineer to bring packaging engineering expertise in-house and develop packaging for Oura’s current and future products.

You will ensure each solution protects the product, supports a considered unboxing experience, and can be manufactured reliably at scale.You will work closely with Product, Product Design, Industrial Design, Brand and Creative, Sourcing, Quality, Operations, and external suppliers.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for an engineer who can turn product and experience requirements into detailed packaging designs, clear engineering documentation, and production-ready solutions.
sentences: Enhance your health journey with Oura.
The Oura Ring provides round-the-clock insights into sleep, fitness, and stress for wellness.
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential.
Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app.
We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.
Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team.
As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.
We are looking for a Senior Packaging Product Design Engineer to bring packaging engineering expertise in-house and develop packaging for Oura’s current and future products.
You will own the structural and mechanical design of packaging; from early concepts and prototypes through validation, production release, and sustaining.

You will ensure each solution protects the product, supports a considered unboxing experience, and can be manufactured reliably at scale.You will work closely with Product, Product Design, Industrial Design, Brand and Creative, Sourcing, Quality, Operations, and external suppliers.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for an engineer who can turn product and experience requirements into detailed packaging designs, clear engineering documentation, and production-ready solutions.
At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being.

Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.
Ōura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location.

These ranges may be modified in the future.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
